Implement incremental undirected graph connectivity in C++17 using disjoint-set union.
Input starts with t. Each case contains n q followed by q operations k u v.
Vertices are 1-based. Operation 1 u v adds an undirected edge; 2 u v asks if u and v are connected.
Initially there are n isolated vertices. Self edges, repeated edges, and q=0 are allowed.
Output YES or NO on a separate line for each query. Sum of n + q across cases is at most 200000.
Use path compression and union by size/rank, O((n+q) alpha(n)) time and O(n) storage.
Produce solution.cpp, a correctness argument, complexity, and executable boundary/random tests.
Sample input:
1
4 5
2 1 2
1 1 2
1 2 3
2 1 3
2 1 4
Sample output:
NO
YES
NO
